# Welcome to Spatial Mailbox! 
A new way to message your friends!

Use your hands to compose and send fun 3D messages to your friends and pen pals! From birthday wishes to silly memes, getting messages is more fun with Mailbox!

📬 **Send & Receive Spatial Mail**
[media]

💯 **Write Anything**

Type or dictate 3D messages with expressive fonts, depth, and animated effects.
[media]

😃 **Place GIFS & Emojis**

Add expressive GIFs, emojis, and effects to bring your 3D messages to life.
[media]

🎨 **Draw Masterpieces**

Create fun 3D drawings with simple brush tools!
[media]

❤️**Send Fun!**

Seal your letter up in a customizable envelope and ship it off!
[media]

LAUNCHING SOON:
Halloween and Winter packs

Sincerely, 

The Mailbox Team
